title: Thorax Ontology v0.1 - typed relationships
description: Edges added by the thorax domain. The included heart edges come from ontology/heart/relationships.json unchanged. Conventions are the heart ontology's: inverses and symmetric relations are declared once, and left_of / right_of use the subject's own left and right.

conventions.functional: Pulmonary circulation joins the heart's two circuits: the pulmonary arteries exit into each lung and each lung exits into the pulmonary veins. Granularity 'any', so the flow model uses these at every LOD. The heart ontology's boundary at the pulmonary arteries still applies when the heart is loaded alone.
